//: Sample MCP client config wiring Friday's primitives as a stdio server.
//_clients: The same mcpServers block works for Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json), Claude Code (.mcp.json) and Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json) - see docs/mcp.md for exact file locations and platform notes.
//_paths: REPLACE <REPO> with the absolute repo path. On Windows use the venv Scripts python (forward slashes work too); on macOS/Linux use .venv/bin/python. Use the venv python directly - GUI clients do not inherit your shell PATH, so a bare 'friday-mcp' will not resolve.
//_env: Optional env vars the server process inherits: credentials (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_*, GMAIL_*, ...) and FRIDAY_LOG_FILE. On Windows, set these at USER level (setx) - GUI clients don't see shell exports.
